The SC846 evaluation kit pairs the `EV-SC846-SOM` with the
`EV-SOMCRR2-EZKIT` carrier board. The processor has two 1.2 GHz Cortex-A55
cores and one 1.2 GHz SHARC FX core. Bare-metal or FreeRTOS applications for
the SHARC core can be loaded by Linux through remoteproc.

From `buildroot/`, select the board and apply the debug image fragments:

```bash
make BR2_EXTERNAL="${PWD}/.." adi_sc846_ezkit_defconfig
support/kconfig/merge_config.sh .config \
    ../configs/buildroot.fragment \
    ../configs/debug.fragment
make -j$(nproc)
```

The Xilinx based targets are built in CI/CD using the ADSP approach documented
in ADSP. Additionally, a non-standard ADI specific approach is also
maintained and documented below.

A small wrapper at the repo root mirrors the in-tree workflow without having
to `cd buildroot/` first:

```bash
make buildroot                   # clone & patch (skips if buildroot/ exists)
make zynq_pluto_defconfig        # from ./configs and forwarded to Buildroot
make -j$(nproc)

`patches/buildroot/` holds ADI-specific Buildroot changes (package fix-ups,
kernel build glue, etc.). These are already merged into the ADI Buildroot
fork the submodule points at, so they are normally no-ops at build time. They
are kept here as an applicable set so the same image can be built agains

- ADSP-SC598 Evaluation Kits: ADI SC598 EZ-KIT and EZLITE.
- ADSP-SC846 Evaluation Kit: ADI SC846 EZ-KIT.

```bash
git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/analogdevicesinc/br2-external.git
cd br2-external/buildroot
# build Buildroot configuration for adi_sc598_ezkit
make BR2_EXTERNAL="${PWD}/.." adi_sc598_ezkit_defconfig
```
